refnamediv.refpurpose: Returns a collection of descendant elements that have the given classes

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
classNames
One or more class names separated by ASCII whitespace. An element only matches if it has every one of these classes, in any order.
Class names are compared case-sensitively, unless the document is in quirks mode, in which case the comparison is ASCII case-insensitive.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns a Dom\HTMLCollection of the matching elements. The collection is empty if no element matches, or if classNames contains no class name, for example when it is an empty string or only whitespace.
